title: Momcozy Smart WiFi Baby Monitor, APP Control Baby Monitor with Camera&Audio
bullets: 【Smart Motion Detection for Extra Assurance】Real-time motion alerts via APP notify you of your baby's movements, including potential dangers like a covered face or face-down sleeping. This baby video monitor keeps you informed and confident that your baby is safe. (Motion Alerts Notifications Appear Only in the APP)

【Danger Zone Alert for Added Safety】Stay one step ahead with instant app notifications when your baby leaves a designated safe area. With this wifi baby monitor, you'll be alerted immediately so you can respond and keep them safe without delay.

【1080P HD Resolution】With the 1080p HD camera, you can see the details of the picture more clearly, whether day or night. At the same time, the 2x to 4x zoom function of the Momcozy baby monitor allows you to observe your baby up close.

【Shared Video Access to Enhance Family Bonds】Bring loved ones closer by sharing video access with up to 20 family members. With the baby monitor camera, they can watch your baby grow and celebrate milestones, even from afar.

【Auto Video Recording for Precious Memories】Never miss a moment! The video monitor baby camera offers continuous or motion-activated recording to capture every milestone. With just a tap or press, you can also take photos or record videos manually using the app.

【APP Connection Support, Up to 4 Cameras】The BM04 separate camera can be used in conjunction with the APP, without an additional screen. It only takes 5 seconds to pair the additional camera unit with the Momcozy baby monitor BM04 (B0DQXPWHSK), and up to 4 camera units can be connected at a time. Meet your needs to care for multiple children, and can be placed in different rooms so as not to miss any baby activities.
